name: Curocell Inc.
summary: Curocell Inc., a cell gene therapy development company, engages in the development and manufacturing of pharmaceuticals. It provides research and development services; and OVercome Immune Suppression (OVIS), a proprietary platform technology designed to get away from exhaustion induced by immune checkpoint receptors. The company is also involved in the development of CD19 CAR-T treatment, blood cancer CAR-T, solid cancer CAR-T, and allogeneic CAR-T. Curocell Inc. was founded in 2016 and is headquartered in Daejeon, South Korea.
